Gurbir Singh, J (Oral)
The prayer in the present petition is for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in case FIR No.184, dated 08.07.2022, under Sections 17-A, 17-B, 18(c), 27(b)(ii), 27(c), 27(d), 36-AC of the Drugs & Cosmetics Act, Section 63 of the Copyright Act and Section 420 of IPC, registered at Police Station Civil Lines Jind, District Jind.
Learned State counsel submits that in compliance of the order dated 30.11.2022, the petitioner has already joined the investigation and he is not required for any custodial interrogation.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Vide order dated 30.11.2022, the petitioner was granted the interim protection.
In view of above, the order dated 30.11.2022 granting interim bail to the petitioner, is made absolute.
The petitioner shall abide by the 1 of 2 conditions as laid down under Section 438(2)
Cr.P.C. in letter and spirit.
Petition is disposed of accordingly.
